title: Mushroom Office Sorceress
description: A surreal scene inside a dark green kitchen or office where a blue-haired horned figure in black armor stands behind a green counter. Giant red and white mushrooms with dripping undersides hang from the ceiling like a chandelier, while smaller mushrooms grow on the counters and floor. Framed pictures hang on the walls and a rocky landscape is visible through an opening on the right.
